notes.title: Airflow 0.4 Playtest
notes.content:
Test new features such as the in-game tutorial, flight strip bay, flight board, and improved navigation system. The goal of this playtest is to solidify the core features of approach control before adding secondary features such as career mode, expanded regions, and multiplayer.

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Departures
[*] Secondary airports
[*] New positions
[*] Dynamic flight scheduler
[*] Steam stats/achievements
[/list]
[h3]Physics[/h3]
[list]
[*] SID/STAR procedures with restrictions
[*] Visual approaches
[*] Navigation (direct, radial, ILS, own nav)
[*] Speeds based on aircraft type
[*] Transition altitude speed restriction
[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Flight board
[*] Flight strip bay
[*] Flight plan page
[*] Coordination page
[*] Post-game stats
[*] In-game tutorial
[*] Fading radar sweep/blips
[/list]
[h3]Video Map[/h3]
Customize your radar scope with relevant navaids, airports, runway centerlines, range rings, etc.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112230/82f79d3c12af32f060a37ff4066ff840f7815244.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112230/b397f0846cbd8529fc5dc0e1faec12242783bb9c.png[/img]
[h3]Flight Board[/h3]
Gauge traffic levels and check flight statuses at each airport.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112230/b30ea295bdfd70c0c38b7fd23f9660af18b28b16.png[/img]
[h3]Flight Strip Bay[/h3]
Sort your flights and quickly lookup routes or vector assignments using flight strips.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112230/787b5b7083213350b89b6603d6f016b51b85d4c7.png[/img]
[h3]In-Game Tutorial[/h3]
Learn the basics of Airflow and complete your first arrival and departure by clicking the 'Tutorial' button on the main menu and following the prompt's instructions.
